content: Chen et al. 2023 (anterior BLA, TRAP2 x Ai14, PMC10174320): absolute counts per section-set, not fractions of DAPI+. TdTomato+ (TRAPed) counts: context 77±3.1, fear 110±6.2. Fos+ (recall) counts: context recall 83±2.5, fear recall 128±5.0. Reactivated double+ counts: context 17±1.8 (20±2.6% of TRAPed), fear 35±2.2 (30±1.5% of TRAPed) — i.e. reactivation fraction (double+/TdT+) ~20-30%, higher with fear conditioning vs context-only. ~70-80% of TRAPed neurons were CaMKII+ (glutamatergic). No explicit chance-level statistical test reported in this paper for this metric.
